post.title: Wood Stove and Fireplace Insert Replacement Mountlake Terrace WA — Permits, Chimney Liners, Clearances and Burn Bans
post.description: A Mountlake Terrace homeowner's guide to replacing an old wood stove or fireplace insert: the City mechanical permit, wood, pellet and gas insert options, stainless chimney liners, hearth and clearance checks, carbon monoxide alarms, burn bans, and how to vet the installer.

notes: Box-authored fallback. Home PC DESKTOP-B69F181 offline; no 2026-10-31 packets.
